quiz.question: What type of power do standard wall outlets deliver?
quiz.explanation: Wall outlets deliver AC (alternating current) power at either 120V (North America) or 230V (most of the world), both of which are far above safe levels.

quiz.question: Why should beginners never work on mains-powered circuits?

answers.answer: The components are too expensive to replace
Mains voltage is more than enough to push lethal current through your body
Mains circuits are too complicated to understand
It voids your home insurance automatically

quiz.explanation: Mains voltage (120V or 230V) can easily push enough current through a human body to kill. This work requires trained electricians, not beginners.

quiz.question: Which of the following activities should you NEVER do as a beginner?

answers.answer: Build a circuit on a breadboard with a 5V USB supply
Connect an LED to a battery with a resistor
Open electrical panels or modify wall outlets

quiz.explanation: Opening electrical panels and modifying wall outlets involves mains voltage, which is extremely dangerous. These tasks require trained electricians.
